scope: Manifest tool entries may declare up to four artifact media types; the declaration is part of catalog/spec fingerprints and therefore part of drift revocation
The host passes one per-extension writable directory through OMNI_EXTENSION_ARTIFACTS; the child rejects symlinks, traversal, missing files and size overruns and computes bytes/SHA-256 itself
Plugin results may only carry name+media_type; the child adds measured bytes/hash, and the service independently re-reads and re-hashes every file before publishing
Verified artifacts become immutable objects; ActionResult.artifacts ids are linked to the action and protected by the existing object reference/GC contract
Model text only receives a bounded summary (media type and bytes); no artifact names or content; ActionResult.data lists {id, media_type, bytes}
Post-dispatch verification failure is UNKNOWN (never failed/retried) and publishes nothing; the per-extension staging directory is cleared before and after every call
